verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Neon API reference page, an LLM-addressed endpoint index with per-endpoint .md pages, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec. Nothing documents an interactive reference or runnable or try-it examples. A static index plus a spec is an adjacent building block, not the interactive, runnable capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
